extension.description: 🔍 Search Type, Method, and Member C# symbols from a dedicated activity bar view.
viewContainer.title: C# Search
view.main.name: C# Search
command.focusView.title: C# Search: Focus Search View
config.title: C# Search
config.excludeFolders.markdownDescriptio: Directories to exclude from C# symbol indexing. Match is by folder name and applies to any level in the workspace path.
config.searchDebounceMs.markdownDescript: Search input debounce in milliseconds before dispatching query (0-1000). Default is 300.
config.updateDebounceMs.markdownDescript: Debounce in milliseconds before applying batched file-change updates to in-memory index (0-5000). Default is 900.
config.persistDebounceMs.markdownDescrip: Debounce in milliseconds before persisting index snapshot to disk after index changes (0-10000). Default is 1200.
config.pageSize.markdownDescription: Number of items loaded per page while scrolling results (20-500). Default is 100.
config.maxResults.markdownDescription: Maximum number of results returned per query (50-1000). Default is 500.
